notes.title: 🎉 New Update is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
A brand-new update for Christmas Journey to Santa is here! This update brings a bunch of improvements to make the journey to meet Santa even more thrilling.

What's New:

✨ Improved Graphics: Discover enhanced visuals that create a cozy atmosphere and set the perfect mood for your adventure!

⚠️ New Obstacles:
🔔 Swinging Bells: Avoid these tricky bells that swing back and forth.
🎯 Snowball Cannons: Be careful—these cannons are shooting snowballs your way!
⚠️ Spiked Ice Balls: Watch out for these hazardous spiked ice balls!

🏆Steam Achievements: Unlock new achievements.

Hopefully, these new additions make the adventure even more enjoyable! Thank you for all the continued support.
